items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He taught me this, one thing I never will forget. He said, 'Look, Phil...' Deak, he called me; he called me Deak. He said, 'Look, Deak. When you're on the bandstand...'

ctx.x: Yeah. So he was going... He said, "Deak, you and Pete, I'm gonna take you all with me. I'm going over with Miss Young." He said, "I'm going to leave this show here with Kitchen."
